summary: Audit found a major personal/payment-data violation (agent asked for card security code), minor issues for promises (contradictory refund statement) and conduct (rude/curt language). No verification or escalation violations were found.

findings.quote: Thanks. Quick check before I process it - what's the 3-digit code on the back of your card?
findings.explanation: The agent asked for the card security code (CVV/CVC). Policy explicitly forbids asking for, repeating or writing out card security codes. The customer then provided the 3-digit code (turn 15) and the agent subsequently validated the purchase (turn 17), indicating the sensitive data was used — confirming the severity of the violation.

findings.quote: As the order is out for delivery you can get full refund but can only get a part of it
findings.explanation: The agent made a contradictory and misleading statement about the refund (saying both a full refund and only part of it are possible). This is misleading and overconfident language about the outcome; it may confuse the customer about what to expect.

findings.quote: You need to make this simple for me
findings.explanation: The agent used a curt and somewhat dismissive phrase that fails to be courteous. Policy marks curt or dismissive tone as a minor conduct violation.
